params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Verified live: values outside 1-100 return HTTP 400 `rest_invalid_param`.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Only `view` and `embed` are available anonymously — `edit` returns HTTP 401.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to. Verified live, e.g. `_fields=id,slug,link,title`.

params.name: _embed
params.description: Embed linked resources (author, featured media, terms) into the response.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to items with one of the given slugs.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit results to pages with the given parent IDs.

params.name: menu_order
params.description: Limit results to pages with a specific menu_order value.

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of published pages on cresilon.com — product pages (TRAUMAGEL, VETIGEL), Instructions For Use, clinical publications, case studies, management, media, distributor portal and legal pages. Verified live 2026-08-04: X-WP-Total: 53.
